module: Flowgraph node "Get Point on Decalroad" (repeat_instant). Gives the position of a control point of a DecalRoad (roadId, idx) and an approximation of its direction (quat). If the road is looped ('looped'), the neighbors of the first/last point wrap around; otherwise they are clamped. The computation is only redone if roadId or idx changes.
notes: idx is 0-based, clamped to [0, getNodeCount()-1]; out of bounds the node does nothing.
The direction is computed as position(previous) - position(next): check the direction if the rotation seems inverted. The code says it is approximate.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the cache (oldRoadId, oldIdx, roadObj) and empties the output pins.

work.desc: Looks up the road, computes pos ({x,y,z} of node idx) and rot (quatFromDir of the next->previous direction, Z up vector).
